model_check: The conditional theorem matches the board model clause by clause: a single uniform randomised classical word-RAM program, word length ceil(4(n+b+log2(n+2))), halts on every input, correct with probability at least 2/3, every random execution costs at most C_c 2^(0.487676n) for every fixed c and b <= n^c, and the program does not depend on c. Source comparison, not a proof check.
